pages.text: The Sieve is used as a tool against placed materials rather than through a separate inventory. I should hold it and work the appropriate block until the material is processed.$(br2)Loose materials can yield refined substances that ordinary mining never exposes. Sea Glass is intended to be one possible chance result of sifting.

Only blocks included in the sieve-compatible block tag respond to the tool. The exact result table belongs here once every siftable material and percentage has been finalized.$(br2)The tool’s durability is consumed through use; ordinary Silk Touch expectations do not apply.
